facts.fact: Deliberation 005/2025 of 30 July 2025 is taken under law 2017-020 of 22 July 2017 and requires controllers to follow the law's prior-formalities regime, which shows the law in operation on that date.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: The APD met on 30 July 2025 under its president with seven named members, under decree 2022-13 of 18 February 2022 on its composition and operation.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Decree 2022-13 of 18 February 2022 on the composition, organisation and operation of the APD is cited as in force alongside the law; the document does not say the decree was made under the law.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Deliberation 005/2025 (30 July 2025, amended) makes prior APD authorisation mandatory for public and private controllers using cloud services abroad and fixes four contract clauses.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: The APD's deliberation 005/2025 of 30 July 2025 requires prior authorisation for use of foreign cloud services under the law's prior-formalities regime.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection
